name: s81dv_land_512-g3a-COMMIT
purpose: S81 p4l3 end-slice lane landing dsfd_dvland_512 (forwarded-clock ring D 4, read on the block root; 8 inst in bind_table_p4l3, G3)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_dvland_512 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/ot_s81_land.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/dsfd_dvland.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: landing_exact_sweep
bench.pass_regex: LAND_BENCH PASS dsfd_dvland_512 base D=4 KW=3 sweep 36/36 slip-fault 4/4

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dv_land_512/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dv_land_512/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_land_512 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_dvland_512  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-MISC 10-18 (G3, S81-LBGAP bind_table_p4l3 5cb5cddc3): first hardened view of the S81 end-slice lane LANDING dsfd_dvland_512 (ot_s81_land W=512 D=4 KW=3; LANDING-CONTRACT L1-L7), 8 instances in p4l3 (G3: the 52 lanes into the end slices get landing tiles). Same structure, faces, clocks (multiple_cts_roots ck_f lane / ck core, related same frequency) and recipe as the CLOSED sibling dsfd_dvland_562 (s81dv_land_562-l1-1da4d6aae, TT +65.82 / FF +26.06); outline kept 38.88 x 95.04 um (513 data pins per face at 5.4/um; std area ~0.91x of 562 -> util below the 562 view). k[2:0] = identity strap tied by the die binder (case-analysed at die STA). route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.03 (KITS 10-18 rule >= 0.025; the 562 kit used 0.0).
